panels.description: Count of all tests that was running

targets.rawSql:
WITH expanded AS
(
    SELECT
        project,
        arrayJoin(
            range(
                toUInt32(start / 1000),
                toUInt32(stop  / 1000)
            )
        ) AS time_sec
    FROM test_results
    WHERE
        start <= $__to
        AND stop  >= $__from
)
SELECT
    time,
    metric,
    running_tests
FROM
(
    SELECT
        toDateTime64(time_sec, 3) AS time,
        project AS metric,
        count(*) AS running_tests
    FROM expanded
    WHERE
        time_sec >= toUnixTimestamp($__from / 1000)
        AND time_sec <= toUnixTimestamp($__to   / 1000)
    GROUP BY
        time,
        metric

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        toDateTime64(time_sec, 3) AS time,
        'TOTAL TESTS' AS metric,
        count(*) AS running_tests
    FROM expanded
    WHERE
        time_sec >= toUnixTimestamp($__from / 1000)
        AND time_sec <= toUnixTimestamp($__to / 1000)
    GROUP BY
        time
)
ORDER BY time, metric;

WITH test_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        upload_time,
        countIf(status = 'passed') AS passed,
        countIf(status = 'failed') AS failed,
        countIf(status = 'broken') AS broken,
        countIf(status = 'skipped') AS skipped,
        countIf(status = 'unknown') AS unknown,
        count(*) AS total
    FROM test_results

)

    passed,
    failed,
    broken,
    skipped, 
    unknown,
    total

    testCaseName as metric,
    status,

    toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(stop),'$TZ') as stopDate,
    statusDetails,
    (stop - start) / 1000 as duration_sec,
    CASE 
        WHEN status = 'passed' THEN 'info'
